title: Venice Gondola $97 for 30 Min. Yangshuo's Bamboo Raft? $28 | China Travel Expert
description:
Same postcard moment — a boat ride through impossibly scenic water — at a fraction of the price.

In Yangshuo (Guilin, Guangxi), the Li River and its tributary the Yulong wind between hundreds of karst peaks that rise straight out of the water. The classic Yulong River bamboo-raft drift costs about ¥200 for a two-person raft (roughly $28) for a 40–50 minute ride; longer routes run to ¥320. Compare that to Venice, where the gondola tariff is fixed by the city at €90 (about $97) for 30 minutes in the day, €110 after 7pm — per boat. Two of the most photographed boat rides on earth; one costs about a third of the other, and gives you more time on the water.

🧭 Expert Tip: agree the exact pier-to-pier route and the price before you step on the raft — a few routes and piers exist, and the longer Jinlong–Jiuxian stretch with its little weirs is the fun one.
